description: Small timber buildings occupy the gentler southern ground. Short entrance spurs connect them to a modest dogleg path, while benches and peripheral tree groups preserve an open central clearing and views toward the ridge.

imaginary.brief: Create Alderfold, a small imaginary hillside retreat on a 180 metre square. Generate actual terrain: a broad smooth ridge near the north edge, about 25 metres above a gentler southern clearing. Place five small huts and one simple pavilion on the gentler part, linked by a modest path with several bends. Add loose tree groups around the edges and a few useful benches. Use 20–26 total objects, varied hut orientations, simple rectangles or low-sided polygons, and no water. Keep all objects comfortably inside the scene with clear paths. Terrain is the landform; do not add cone or pyramid landmark mountains. Simple stock forms are sufficient, with at most one small pavilion recipe.
